theme_and_identity.vibe: Clean, uncluttered consumer app aesthetic — soft backgrounds, minimal iconography, no visual clutter.
theme_and_identity.archetype: Pastel & Soft paired with 'Clay & Crisp' Neumorphism.
theme_and_identity.theme_mode: light (enforced to match warm neutral base request)

headings.usage: Primary titles, quiz questions, scorecard results. Anti-pattern: Never use Inter or Roboto for headings.

body.usage: UI labels, MCQ options, descriptive text, table data.

usage_mapping.login_screen: Primary highlight: Amber (#FFA900). Use for focus rings, subtle glows, or dark button hover states.
usage_mapping.quiz_engine: Primary highlight: Cyan (#00F0FF). Use for progress bar fills, selected MCQ option borders.
usage_mapping.scorecard: Primary highlight: Green (#00FF81). Use for success metrics, score emphasis.
usage_mapping.wait_screen: Primary highlight: Orange (#FF6800). Use for lock icon accents, pulse animations.
usage_mapping.admin_panel: Monochrome base with Cyan highlights for active tabs/actions.

colors.contrast_warning: CRITICAL: The requested accents are very bright. NEVER use them as text on light backgrounds or with white text. When using accents as backgrounds, text MUST be #1C1917. When used on dark buttons (bg-stone-900), accents can be used as text colors on hover.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Clay & Crisp technique: Surfaces (#FFFFFF) on base (#F9F8F6) must use a 1px solid border (border-black/5) combined with a soft, diffuse shadow (shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]). No muddy grays.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Default state: bg-stone-900 text-white. Hover state: bg-stone-800, with text changing to the screen's specific accent color.
visual_enhancers.mcq_cards: Massive touch targets. p-6 or p-8, rounded-2xl. Default: bg-white border-black/5. Hover: -translate-y-1, subtle shadow. Active/Selected: 2px solid Cyan border with a subtle Cyan background tint (bg-[#00F0FF]/10).

layouts.general: Mobile-first, responsive. Generous spacing (p-8 to p-12).
layouts.quiz_view: Center the active question card. Max-w-3xl. Top of screen should feature a thin, elegant progress bar (h-1 or h-2) tracking 1 to 5.
layouts.admin_view: Dense Bento grid layout for stats, cleanly spaced table for participants. Full width but with max-w-7xl constraint and generous p-8 internal padding.

motion.micro_interactions: MCQ options: scale 1.01 on hover, scale 0.98 on tap. Smooth 0.2s ease transitions.
motion.page_transitions: Use Framer Motion. Question Cards must slide in (x: 20, opacity: 0) and out gracefully.
motion.score_reveal: Animate the score counting up. The tier Emoji should pop in with a spring animation (scale: 0 to 1, bounce).

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements, inputs, and text reveals MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='login-submit-button'`, `data-testid='mcq-option-a'`).
accessibility.focus: Always use focus-visible with a 2px ring matching the screen's mapped accent color.

media.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular weight). Keep iconography minimal.
media.score_emojis: Use native OS emojis rendered massively (text-7xl+) for the scorecard tiers instead of complex imagery.

component_rules.forms: Use Shadcn UI for inputs and forms, but customize to remove Vercel defaults. Inputs should be rounded-xl, bg-white, border-black/10, h-12 or h-14 for comfortable typing.
component_rules.admin_table: Use Shadcn Table. Flat design, no inner borders, generous row padding (py-4).
component_rules.language_toggle: Minimal pill toggle (USA / UK) placed discreetly in the top-right corner of the layout.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using React (.jsx). Do not generate TypeScript.
Implement the single global session lock using a robust state or context mechanism. Show the 'wait screen' if locked.
Store the 100-question bank logically so it can be 'replaced' via the Admin Excel upload (mock or implement basic parse logic).
Apply the font setup in index.css exactly as specified.
Limit to the specific 4 accent colors. Follow the usage mapping exactly.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs ('AI slop'). Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Don't make generic centered layouts or uniform styling. Create depth with 'Clay & Crisp' borders and soft shadows.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., `transition: all`). This breaks transforms. Target transitions explicitly.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in CSS.
NEVER use fully transparent backgrounds on elements sitting over content.
ALWAYS include `data-testid` for automated testing hooks on all interactables and significant UI elements.
